title: Meeting consent
description: Whether participants are told that a meeting is recorded and transcribed, and whether their consent is needed first. This is the deployment's default; a meeting can be started with a different choice unless that is turned off below. What LMA records is supporting evidence of what participants said, not a legal determination of consent; see the Meeting Consent documentation.
appliesText: A saved change applies to meetings whose consent starts after the save; a meeting already under way keeps the mode and rule it started with.

mode.title: Consent mode
mode.description: Off: no notice. Notify: a notice is posted and the meeting is recorded and transcribed unless a participant objects, which stops it. Opt-in: a request is posted and nothing is recorded or transcribed until the consent rule below is met; an objection stops it again.

consentRule.title: Consent rule (opt-in)
consentRule.description: Each participant: every participant present replies with consent. Owner attests: the meeting's owner confirms that everyone agreed, for example out loud or in the invitation's terms.

enumLabels.owner_attests: The meeting owner attests that everyone agreed

notifyNoticeText.title: Notice text (notify)
notifyNoticeText.description: Posted when a notify meeting starts. {LMA_USER} is the person using LMA, {meeting} the meeting's name, and {consent_phrase} and {objection_phrase} the first phrase of each list below.

optInNoticeText.title: Consent request text (opt-in)
optInNoticeText.description: Posted when an opt-in meeting starts. The same placeholders as the notice text.

consentPhrases.title: Consent phrases
consentPhrases.description: Comma-separated. A reply containing one of these, as whole words and ignoring case and punctuation, is read as consent, unless it also contains an objection phrase.

objectionPhrases.title: Objection phrases
objectionPhrases.description: Comma-separated. A reply containing one of these is read as an objection. Objections are looked for first, so "I do not consent" is an objection although it contains "consent".

allowPerMeetingOverride.title: Allow a different choice per meeting
allowPerMeetingOverride.description: On: whoever starts a meeting may choose another mode or rule for it. Off: a meeting may only use this mode and rule or a stricter one.

keepEvidenceScreenshots.title: Keep evidence screenshots
keepEvidenceScreenshots.description: On: screenshots kept as consent evidence stay with the meeting until it is deleted. Off: each screenshot is deleted as soon as it has been checked, and only the check's result is kept.

verifierModelId.title: Evidence check model
verifierModelId.description: The Amazon Bedrock vision model that checks a consent evidence screenshot: whether the notice is visible, which replies are visible and from whom, and whether anybody objected. Its answer is supporting evidence only; it never changes a meeting's consent status. Image-capable models only.
